chunks: Abu Hamzah al-Thumali narrated, saying: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام said to me:
When death approached my father عليه السلام, he drew me to his chest, then said: “O my son, be patient upon the truth, even if it is bitter; your reward will be given to you without measure.”

key_terms.اصْبِرْ عَلَى الْحَقِّ: remain patient and steadfast upon the truth
key_terms.الْحَقِّ: the truth; what is right and just

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir’s father عليهما السلام advise him when death approached?
ai.summary: This hadith records a final piece of counsel from an Imam to his son at the approach of death. It teaches steadfast patience upon the truth, even when difficult, with the promise of immense reward from Allah beyond measure.
